Remark
[pointed $C^{m,\alpha }$ convergence implies GH convergence]

Source: petersen:page-0428 ↗ def:pet-ch11-pointed-cmalpha-convergence ↗ def:pet-ch11-pointed-gh-topology Pointed $C^{m,\alpha }$ convergence entails pointed Gromov--Hausdorff convergence. When all manifolds are closed with uniformly bounded diameter, the $F_i$ are diffeomorphisms, so one may speak of unpointed convergence, which forces all manifolds in the tail of the sequence to be diffeomorphic; classes of closed manifolds precompact in some $C^{m,\alpha }$ topology contain at most finitely many diffeomorphism types.
